h1:
Where to Stay in Koh Samui?
10 Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Ten Koh Samui hotels across every budget — 5-star pool villas above Lamai and Choeng Mon, down to value beachfront bungalows and a hostel. Covering the main beaches: Chaweng, Lamai, Choeng Mon, Bophut, and Maenam. Starting from around ฿900–18,000/night.
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right beach on Koh Samui matter?
introHtml: Koh Samui has several beaches that feel completely different from one another — Chaweng is the long, lively main beach with the most restaurants and nightlife · Lamai is a little quieter than Chaweng but still has plenty to eat and do · Choeng Mon is a small, calm bay made for relaxing · Bophut (Fisherman's Village) has the charm of old shophouses and cafes · and Maenam on the north shore is the quietest, good for families and anyone escaping the crowds. Many travellers book without checking which beach, then spend the whole trip crossing the island back and forth. This guide brings together 10 Koh Samui hotels we've reviewed across every tier — from luxury pool villas down to value beachfront bungalows. Every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Samui has no city-style public transport — the main ways to get around are renting a scooter or car, taxis/ride apps, or the shared songthaew trucks that run the ring road. From Samui Airport (USM) it's about 10–15 minutes to Chaweng and 20–30 minutes to Lamai. The main beaches in this guide: Chaweng — long, lively beach, restaurants, nightlife (Chaweng Regent, OZO, Lub d, La Vida, SALA) · Lamai — quieter than Chaweng, still plenty to eat and do (Banyan Tree, Lamai Wanta) · Choeng Mon — small, calm bay (Garrya Tongsai Bay) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village — old shophouses, cafes, evening walking street (GREENLIGHT, The Waterfront).

entries.name: Banyan Tree Samui
entries.addr: 99/9 Moo 4, Maret, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.5 — Banyan Tree Samui is Koh Samui's top-tier pool-villa luxury stay, set on a hillside above Lamai bay where every villa comes with a private infinity pool and a sala. Reviews mention the sea views from the villas, the butler service and the Banyan Tree spa most often. It's a resort that sells privacy and seclusion, ideal for a honeymoon or a special-occasion trip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Choose an Ocean View Pool Villa if the budget allows — the Lamai bay view from the private pool is what reviews highlight most, and book spa treatments ahead.
pros: Every villa is a pool villa with a private pool and sala
Lamai bay views from the hillside villas, very private (per reviews)
Banyan Tree spa, frequently praised in reviews
Attentive butler service — great for honeymooners
cons: Highest price in this guide — best for a special occasion
Hillside layout means a resort buggy to reach the beach, not a direct beach walk

entries.name: Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Choeng Mon · Tongsai Bay · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 84 Moo 5, Bophut, Choeng Mon, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Garrya Tongsai Bay is a luxury eco resort on its own private Tongsai bay, scoring 9.4 from 410 reviews. What reviews mention most is the calm, private feel of the bay, the suites scattered across a wooded hillside, and the balcony bathtub with a sea view in almost every room. It leans into nature and quiet — a different mood from the busy Chaweng strip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a room with the balcony bath and view — reviews keep mentioning a morning soak overlooking the sea — and the resort is large, so call for a buggy.
pros: Private Tongsai bay, quiet and secluded (per reviews)
Balcony bath with a sea view in almost every room
Lush, natural hillside setting — restful
High 9.4 score from a solid 410 reviews
cons: Large, hilly grounds — tiring on foot, needs a buggy
Nature-and-quiet focus, not for those who want nightlife next door

entries.name: SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Chaweng Beach · Bo Phut · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 99/10 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: SALA Samui is the most-reviewed hotel in this guide — over 1,715 reviews — a pool-villa resort right on Chaweng Beach, scoring 9.1. Reviews most often praise the white minimalist design, the many rooms that come with a private pool, and the choice between a quieter Garden Wing and an Oceanfront Wing depending on budget. Being on Chaweng means you can walk to restaurants and nightlife, while the resort itself stays calm and private.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a direct sea view choose the Oceanfront Wing; the Garden Pool Villa is better value if you mainly want a private pool. Book ahead in high season as it fills fast.
pros: Most reviewed in the guide — 1,715 reviews, 9.1 score
Many rooms come with a private pool
Beautiful white minimalist design, often praised (photogenic)
On Chaweng Beach — walk to restaurants and nightlife
cons: Some Garden Wing rooms don't have a direct sea view — check the room type
On busy Chaweng, so not as quiet as a private-bay resort

entries.name: Lub d Koh Samui Chaweng Beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Chaweng Beach · near nightlife · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 159/99 Moo 2, Bophut, Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Lub d is the cheapest stay in this guide from just ฿900, yet right on Chaweng Beach, scoring a remarkable 9.3 from 240 reviews — very high for a hostel. What reviews call out is the dorm beds with a privacy curtain, power socket and reading light, the lively common areas and bar that make it easy to meet people, and private king rooms for those who want more privacy. Ideal for solo and social travellers on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want more privacy but still on Chaweng Beach, the Duo Sea View private room is still far better value than most beachfront hotels.
pros: Cheapest in the guide at ฿900 — right on Chaweng Beach
Dorm beds with privacy curtain, power socket and reading light
Lively common areas and bar — easy to meet people
Very high 9.3 score for a hostel · private rooms available
cons: A social hostel — bar noise possible, not for those wanting quiet
Dorms use shared bathrooms, not suited to families with young kids

entries.name: La Vida Samui
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.9 · 472 reviews · quieter north end of Chaweng
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chaweng · north end near Bophut · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 101 Moo 2, Chaweng Beach, Bophut, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: La Vida Samui is a boutique beachfront at the quiet north end of Chaweng, scoring 8.9 from 472 reviews. What reviews highlight is getting Chaweng Beach but at the calmer end, not far from Bophut. It ranges from accessible Deluxe rooms to a Beachfront Pool Villa for those who want a private pool — a good fit if you want to be on Chaweng without the busiest stretch.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Upgrade to a Seaview Deluxe for a sea view worth the small extra, and walk along the sand toward central Chaweng when you want the buzz.
pros: On Chaweng but at the quieter north end (per reviews)
Range from accessible rooms to a beachfront pool villa
Not far from Bophut, with a beach walk into central Chaweng
8.9 score from a solid 472 reviews
cons: At the end of the beach — a walk or ride to reach the nightlife
The cheapest Deluxe rooms have no sea view — pick Seaview for that

entries.name: OZO Chaweng Samui
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Chaweng Beach · beachfront · near nightlife
entries.addr: 11/34 Moo 2, Chaweng Beach Road, Bophut, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: OZO Chaweng is a beachfront hotel in the heart of Chaweng with a large 1,148 reviews, scoring 8.5. Reviews most often praise the central Chaweng location — easy walking to restaurants and nightlife — while still being beachfront. Rooms are clean and modern, ranging from accessible Superior up to Deluxe Beachfront. A good pick to be in the middle of Chaweng's buzz without paying a premium.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Upgrade to a Deluxe Ocean View for the view, and street-side rooms can pick up nightlife noise — request a sea-facing room if you want it quieter.
pros: Central Chaweng location, walk to nightlife (per reviews)
Beachfront · a large 1,148 reviews
Clean modern rooms, accessible starting price
Several room tiers to suit the budget, up to Deluxe Beachfront
cons: Central Chaweng — street-side rooms can hear nightlife
The central beach gets busy, not as quiet as a private bay

entries.name: GREENLIGHT Fisherman's Village Resort
entries.storyHtml: GREENLIGHT is a boutique resort with a cafe in the heart of Fisherman's Village, Bophut, scoring 8.9. What reviews highlight is the location among Bophut's charming old shophouses — easy strolling to cafes and the evening walking street, near Bophut Beach. Rooms are charming and boutique with an in-house cafe. A great fit if you prefer old-town atmosphere over a long, lively beach like Chaweng. Review count is still small (40) but consistently high.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're visiting Bophut, time your stay for a Walking Street night and just walk over from the hotel.
pros: In the heart of charming Fisherman's Village (per reviews)
Stroll to cafes, the walking street and Bophut Beach
Charming boutique rooms with an in-house cafe
Consistently high 8.9 score
cons: Still few reviews (40) versus the bigger hotels on the list
Small boutique — no big-resort facilities

entries.name: Chaweng Regent Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Chaweng Beach · Bo Phut · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 155/4 Chaweng Beach Road, Bo Phut, Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Chaweng Regent is a beach resort on Chaweng set in leafy gardens, scoring 8.6. Reviews most often praise the on-beach Chaweng location with gardens and a pool that make the grounds feel greener than a high-rise hotel. It ranges from Deluxe rooms up to Family rooms and a Spa Villa Suite, so it suits families — a mid-priced beachfront resort that balances location and space.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a family, pick the Grand Premier Family Room for the space, and garden-side rooms are quieter than the road side.
pros: On Chaweng Beach, set in leafy gardens (per reviews)
Swimming pool and Family rooms — good for families
Garden-resort feel, greener than a high-rise
Mid-price, balancing location and room space
cons: Still few reviews (72) versus the bigger hotels on the list
Parts of the resort show their age — pick a renovated room

entries.name: The Waterfront Boutique Hotel
entries.storyHtml: The Waterfront is a boutique beachfront bungalow stay in Bophut's Fisherman's Village, scoring 8.4. What reviews highlight is the beachfront bungalows where you step out onto the sand, close to Bophut's old shophouse area for cafes and markets. There are 2-bedroom rooms for families or groups and an in-house cafe. A good fit for those who like a quiet beachfront bungalow near the old town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling in a group, the 2 Bedroom Beach Front gives a direct sea view and good value, and walk into Fisherman's Village in the evening for food.
pros: Beachfront bungalows, step out onto the sand (per reviews)
Near Fisherman's Village — stroll to cafes and markets
2-bedroom rooms suit families or groups
In-house cafe, quiet boutique atmosphere
cons: Still few reviews (52), a small boutique
Bophut Beach is better for strolling than swimming, unlike Chaweng or Lamai

entries.name: Lamai Wanta Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Lamai Beach · central Lamai · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 124/264 Moo 3, Maret, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Lamai Wanta is a good-value beachfront resort on Lamai with a large 747 reviews, scoring 8.0. What reviews highlight is the central Lamai location on the beach, within walking distance of restaurants and the market, plus a swimming pool and garden bungalows to choose from. From just ฿2,000 you get a beachfront spot — a good fit for mid-budget travellers who want Lamai, which is a touch quieter than Chaweng.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a family, pick the Family Deluxe Villa, or a garden bungalow, which is roomier and brighter than the block rooms.
pros: On Lamai Beach, central, walk to restaurants and market (per reviews)
From ฿2,000, good value for beachfront · a large 747 reviews
Swimming pool and garden bungalows to choose from
Lamai is a touch quieter than Chaweng — good for mid-budget
cons: Middling 8.0 score; some block rooms are dated — pick a bungalow/villa
Parts of Lamai Beach have rocks and surf — check the swimming spots

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare the 3 sites before booking. During Koh Samui high season (December–April, especially New Year and Songkran) prices rise and rooms sell out fast, so book 1–2 months ahead. Koh Samui has no metro — get around by rental scooter or car, taxi, or shared songthaew; from Samui Airport it's about 10–15 minutes to Chaweng. Scores and standout factors come from reading real guest reviews, not from staying ourselves. Article by ThailandAddict.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Koh Samui hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which beach should I stay on in Koh Samui?
faq.a: It depends on your style · Chaweng suits those who want a long, lively beach with restaurants and nightlife (Chaweng Regent, OZO, Lub d, La Vida, SALA) · Lamai is a touch quieter than Chaweng but still has plenty to eat and do (Banyan Tree, Lamai Wanta) · Choeng Mon is a small, calm bay (Garrya Tongsai Bay) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village is a charming old shophouse area with lots of cafes (GREENLIGHT, The Waterfront).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Samui hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and beachfront bungalows start around ฿900–2,500/night · mid-range to 4-star beachfront hotels and resorts run about ฿2,500–5,500 · pool villas and 5-star resorts start ฿7,500–18,000+ · during high season (December–April, especially New Year and Songkran) prices can be much higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Koh Samui hotel?
faq.a: For low season and weekdays, booking 2–4 weeks ahead is enough · but in high season (December–April), especially New Year, Songkran and long weekends, the good rooms — particularly pool villas and beachfront resorts — sell out fast, so book 1–2 months ahead or more.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest to book a Koh Samui hotel?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion at different times — we recommend comparing all 3 before every booking. Each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save you hundreds to over a thousand baht per night on the higher-priced rooms.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get around Koh Samui with no public transport?
faq.a: Koh Samui has no city-style public transport — the main options are renting a scooter or car, taxis/ride apps, or shared songthaew trucks along the ring road · if you're staying several days and want to visit several beaches, a rental is more convenient and cheaper · from Samui Airport (USM) it's about 10–15 minutes to Chaweng.

faq.q: ❓ When is the best time to visit Koh Samui?
faq.a: Koh Samui's rainy season differs from the Andaman coast · the best weather is roughly December–April, with clear skies and calm seas (this is high season, so prices are higher) · the wettest months are October–November · other months see passing showers rather than all-day rain, so it's still good for travel and cheaper.
